title: VIC-II RC window state machine cycle-accurate
body: VIC-II row counter (RC) and video counter (VC) state machine matches VICE viciisc/vicii-cycle.c:541-563. VC update at RasterX=13: vc=vcBase, vmli=0, bad line sets rc=0. RC update at RasterX=57: rc==7 sets idle; if not idle or bad line, rc=(rc+1)&7.
